module_summary: Moore FSM that, after start input s, examines w in repeating 3-cycle windows and asserts z when exactly two were 1.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Encodes idle A plus cycle position and ones-count within each 3-cycle w window.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Decoded from state C; flags a window with exactly two ones.

anchors.name: s
anchors.why: Start input; only leaves idle state A to begin checking w.

groups.name: window_checker_fsm
groups.description: Next-state logic counts ones of w per 3-cycle window; z decoded from C.
